description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects traversal components in the Gladinet storage s query argument.
affected_versions: Gladinet CentreStack and TrioFox: 0 through 16.7.10368.56560; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects traversal components in the Gladinet storage s query argument.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate values intentionally containing parent-directory markers are denied.
